def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    person_patches = image_patch.find("person")
    throw_patches = image_patch.find("throwing")
    
    if not person_patches or not throw_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    person_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2, (p.lower + p.upper) / 2 for p in person_patches]
    throw_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2, (p.lower + p.upper) / 2 for p in throw_patches]
    
    closest_person = min(person_patches, key=lambda p: min(distance(p, t) for t in throw_patches))
    return closest_person

        max(guy_on_right.upper, closest_laptop.upper)
    )

def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    hand_patches = image_patch.find("hand")
    hip_patches = image_patch.find("hip")

    if not hand_patches or not hip_patches:
        return image_patch

    hand_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2, (p.upper + p.lower) / 2 for p in hand_patches]
    hip_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2, (p.upper + p.lower) / 2 for p in hip_patches]

    closest_hand = min(hand_centers, key=lambda h: sum((h[i] - hip_centers[0][i]) ** 2 for i in range(2)))
    closest_hand_patch = hand_patches[hand_centers.index(closest_hand)]

    return closest_hand_patch

    skates_patches = image_patch.find("skates")
